title: Failure-bit bound for a finite family
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\mathcal F$ be a nonempty finite family of subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $\delta\in\mathbb Q$ satisfy $0<\delta\le 1/2$. Set $\delta_{\mathcal F}=\delta/|\mathcal F|$ and $b(\eta)=\lceil\log_2\lceil 2/\eta\rceil\rceil$ for positive rational $\eta$. Then $b(\delta_{\mathcal F})\le 40|\mathcal F|$.
hypotheses_covered: $\mathcal F$ is a finite family of subsets of $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$
